gaps.explanation: No business-type schedule exists in the report, so detail[] has no utility lines. JSON statement receipts = p6 Totals rows User Fees 6,396,665 + Other Services Fees 5,072 + Intergovernmental 397,935 + Miscellaneous income (expense) 9,730 + Interest Income 21,435 = 6,830,837. Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6, printed p11), per column: Rescue Squad 105,078 + 14,911 + 13,569 + 118 = 133,676; Water 683,318 + 5,072 - 65,270 - 5,574 + 3,992 = 621,538; Sewer 288,366 + 1,565 = 289,931; Solid Waste 97,848 - 25 = 97,823; Care Center 5,222,055 + 448,294 + 195 + 17,325 = 5,687,869. Sum 6,830,837 = statement total. Negative amounts are printed in parentheses on the nonoperating rows (Water Intergovernmental (65,270), Miscellaneous (5,574); Solid Waste Miscellaneous (25)) and are kept as printed, as the statement totals net them. Transfers print '-' in every column.
